top_story.headline: A quiet day on the ethics and disclosure beat; lobbying registrations lead
top_story.dek: No new OGE filings, FARA registrations or unreported financial disclosures surfaced, so new lobbying registrations are the main activity.
paragraphs: The Senate lobbying database posted 44 new registrations, including a first-ever registration by Everpure, Inc. through The Vogel Group on artificial intelligence and cybersecurity policy. Every House and Senate financial disclosure filed since October 4 had already been reported in earlier editions.

sections.headline: No new OGE ethics filings flagged this cycle
paragraphs: The Office of Government Ethics filing database shows 30 ethics documents submitted in the past three days, but none are new to our tracking and none require flagging. Routine annual and periodic financial disclosures continue as filed.

sections.headline: 44 new lobbying registrations, led by health care and defense clients
paragraphs: The Senate lobbying disclosure database posted 44 new registrations since October 6, among 612 total filings in the window. Medicare/Medicaid and other health issues dominate, with several defense, technology and energy clients. The Vogel Group registered Everpure, Inc. on artificial intelligence, data infrastructure and cybersecurity; it is that client's first-ever lobbying registration (filing).
